LESSON: HADITH ON BRUSHING TEETH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on Etiquette of Eating (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub-stran
Topic 2.3: Hadith on brushing teeth

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on brushing teeth. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: When do you brush your teeth?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene
2. practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah
3. appreciate the importance of brushing teeth to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HADITH ON BRUSHING TEETH
This lesson teaches Hadith on brushing teeth for Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of brushing teeth to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Hadith on brushing teeth using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Hadith on brushing teeth above.
2. Explain Hadith on brushing teeth to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Hadith on brushing teeth.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on brushing teeth with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on brushing teeth important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. When do you brush your teeth?
2. Why do you brush your teeth?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene
2. practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah
3. appreciate the importance of brushing teeth to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
